name: ZOUR x BITEZ Micros 3,000MG Gummies - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Strawberry Kiwi
description: Tropical fruits collide in this next-level collab between Ocho Extracts and Zour Stash. Juicy strawberry meets bright, tangy kiwi in a sweet and tropical pairing with the perfect tart twist. Each 500mg gummy features our signature Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend—half the punch of the original BITEZ for those who want a smoother, more manageable ride. With 6 per bag (3,000mg total), it’s the perfect combo of mouthwatering flavor and balanced potency.
